## Requirements (from the contract §In-scope)
1. Point the export + read paths (`exports/` P27.4 spine-read export, `web/src/lib/data.ts`
   P27.5 data layer, `api/store_pg.py`) at the MATERIALISED resolution/relationship/
   contradiction/coverage tables; retire the compute-on-read shim WHERE materialised, keeping
   the shaper/shim as a documented fallback where the materialized tables are EMPTY (they ARE
   empty on the hosted spine until the deferred hosted materialization runs — degrade honestly,
   never crash, never fabricate).
2. The map shows resolved sites with the honest "N resolved sites (from M observations)"
   framing (replacing observation-level framing); the network shows the P28.2 edges;
   contradictions + coverage are the P28.3/P28.4 real data. Keep the PROVISIONAL disclosure.
3. Cite ADR-101 (already written).

## Cross-cutting invariants
Zero-JS + WCAG 2.2 AA on public pages (script size 0 on content pages; the P27.9 `/curate/**`
island allowance is the only exception); contradictions stay VISIBLE (§3.1); NEVER a total
(§32 — the resolved headline carries its denominator "M observation-level sites", never a
population total; pinned by `assertCoverageMetrics`); append-only reads (no UPDATE/DELETE);
Part VIII (tier-0-only reads). Reuse-not-reimplement (SIG-ENG-035): the P28.1-4 read seams
(`reconcile.materialize.read_materialized_edges`/`read_materialized_contradictions`/
`read_materialized_resolutions`, `inference.materialize.read_materialized_coverage`) are
CONSUMED; the export producer stays read-only + licence-compartmented (unchanged).

## Plan
- **`reconcile/materialize.py`** — add `read_materialized_resolutions(conn)` (mirrors the
  edge/contradiction read seams): the resolution read seam the export consumes for the
  resolved-site count. Append-only read, deterministically ordered.
- **`exports/spine_export.py`** — inside the single `REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY` snapshot, ALSO
  read the four materialized tables (guarded: a missing table/column → `[]`, honest absence,
  never a crash), thread them into the pure `build_spine_export` via `raw` keys. Pure mappers
  (unit-testable, no DB):
  - `_network` prefers `materialized_edges` (P28.2) when present, else the shaping envelope.
  - `_coverage` prefers `materialized_coverage` (P28.4) when present (mapping
    `CompletenessMethod` → the web CoverageMetric kind), else the shaping metrics; then APPENDS
    the resolved-sites + contradictions-visible counted quantities.
  - `resolved_sites_metric(materialized_resolutions, dataset)` → the honest
    "N resolved sites (from M observations)" CoverageMetric (named denominator = "M
    observation-level sites carrying coordinate claims"; never a total). Returns None when no
    materialized resolution intersects a geolocated site → the surface keeps observation framing.
  - `contradictions_visible_metric(materialized_contradictions)` → a counted quantity keeping
    contradictions VISIBLE (open of recorded, both evidence sides retained). None when empty.
  - `_map_layer` description reflects the resolved framing WHEN materialized resolutions exist,
    else the unchanged observation-level description.
- **`web/`** — the resolved-sites + contradictions-visible metrics ride the EXISTING frozen
  CoverageMetric contract, so they render on the landing (`index.astro` `coverage.map`) + the
  coverage page with NO new IA/getter/page/schema. Add the two rows to the fixture
  `COVERAGE_METRICS` (represents the materialized-graph state; the fixture-export harness
  serialises them into `coverage.json` for export-mode too). The PROVISIONAL disclosure on
  `methodology.astro` (resolution-eval.ts) is PRESERVED verbatim.
- **`api/store_pg.py`** — already reads persisted (materialized) contradictions first with the
  compute-on-read fallback (`_annotation_view`); documented as the read-path precedent ADR-101
  generalises to the export. No behavioural change needed (verified).
- Live: the hosted materialized tables are EMPTY until the deferred hosted materialization runs
  (D-R6.x) + OSM land (D-SOURCES.17-1); prove the FULL path over SEEDED materialized data on a
  real PG18+PostGIS testcontainer; the hosted republish is deferred (`D-R6.5-SURFACE`) with the
  exact re-run command — no fabricated hosted resolved-site count.

## Test matrix
- unit (`tests/exports/test_spine_export.py`): `resolved_sites_metric` builds the
  "N resolved sites (from M observations)" phrasing with a named denominator + is_population_total
  false; returns None over empty resolutions (degrade). `contradictions_visible_metric` counts
  open-of-recorded, None over empty. `_network` prefers materialized edges, falls back to the
  shaping envelope when empty. `_coverage` maps materialized coverage → CoverageMetric kinds +
  appends the resolved/contradiction rows; falls back to shaping metrics when empty. The map
  layer description flips to resolved framing only when resolutions present. No-total pin: every
  emitted coverage metric passes `assert_no_population_total`-equivalent (named denominator).
- db (Docker, `tests/db/test_spine_export_over_seeded_spine.py`): seed a geolocated site +
  materialized resolution/relationship/contradiction/coverage rows on real PG18+PostGIS; run
  `run_spine_export`; assert coverage.json carries the resolved-sites + contradictions-visible
  metrics, network.json is built from the materialized edges, and the session stays read-only.
  The EXISTING seeded test (no materialized rows) proves the honest degrade (observation framing,
  no resolved metric) is unchanged.
- web unit (`web/tests/unit/metrics.test.ts` / `data.test.ts`): the two new CoverageMetrics pass
  `assertCoverageMetric` (named denominator, not a total); getters unchanged.
- web e2e (`corrections-methodology*.spec.ts`): the coverage page shows the resolved-sites
  framing ("resolved sites" + "observations") + the contradictions-visible metric; the
  resolution-eval PROVISIONAL disclosure still renders; zero-`<script>` + axe WCAG 2.2 AA hold.
- live: run_spine_export over hosted spine (deferred D-R6.5-SURFACE) or seeded DB.

## Evidence report
The public export/read surface is re-derived off the MATERIALIZED graph (ADR-101, the
"ADR-R6-MATERIALIZE-092" this ticket calls for — already written at seed, cited not duplicated).
`exports.spine_export.run_spine_export` now reads the four materialized tables — `resolution`
(P28.1), `relationship` (P28.2), `contradiction` (P28.3), `coverage_record` (P28.4) — via the
P28.1-4 read seams (SIG-ENG-035, consumed not re-implemented; the new
`reconcile.materialize.read_materialized_resolutions` completes the set) INSIDE the single
`REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY` snapshot, each guarded by its `input_digest` column and degrading to
`[]` when the table is empty or pre-P28 — the honest state the hosted spine is in until the deferred
hosted materialization runs, never a crash and never a fabricated resolved-site count. When the
materialized rows are present the network reads the real §29.3 sharing edges, the coverage reads the
real §32 coverage, the map layer flips to the resolved framing, and the surface carries the merged

riding the FROZEN `CoverageMetric` contract, so they render on the existing landing + coverage pages
with NO new IA, NO new page/getter/schema, and NO client JS (the metric carries its named
denominator and `is_population_total=false`, so §32 "never a total" holds; N≤M by construction).
When the materialized tables are empty the surface keeps the observation-level framing (proven
